minutes.headline: Select Board ratified key appointments, posted the interim town manager job, and named Alonzo to the screening committee.
minutes.summary: The board heard a BSC Group presentation on redeveloping the old gas station at 925 Mass Ave and made a run of appointments and ratifications. It amended and approved the interim town manager posting, designated a screening committee member, reviewed remaining ARPA funds and a proposed budget task force, and assigned liaisons. The IT email policy, outdoor dining policy and task force were left for later.

Urged better outreach to appointees who miss interviews and asked for a legal interpretation of the charter's temporary town manager section.
Commented on board appointments, interim town manager pay, and cemetery ARPA funds and union workers; was cut off at three minutes.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to post the interim town manager job as amended, with review of applications starting July 9.
The board appointed Selectman Alonzo to the town manager screening committee.
The board ratified the Building Commissioner / land use manager appointment and approved the town manager's slate of annual appointments.
The board worked through the remaining uncommitted ARPA balance and which projects count as committed, but took no ARPA spending vote.
A proposed budget task force was tabled for more work on its makeup and charge, to be drafted using another town's as a model.

why_it_matters: The town is choosing who will run Lunenburg day to day on an interim basis, and the screening process set here shapes who the board sees.

Leftover ARPA money is one-time funding, and how the board sorts committed from uncommitted decides which small projects residents raised, such as the DPW garage and the Council on Aging lot, can still be paid for.
A budget task force, once its charge is settled, would shape how future budgets are built and presented to voters.
watch_next: July meetings are set for the 9th, 16th and 23rd, with none the week of July 4; applications for interim town manager are reviewed starting July 9.
A revised budget task force proposal with its composition and charge.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the seven votes both have (appointments, ratifications, the interim town manager posting and the screening committee), with only name misspellings in the captions. The one thing to know: the official minutes record a second McGrath appointment (Historical Commission) that ours lacks, and ours records several decisions and many ARPA and budget figures that the official minutes do not mention.
